title: File:Émile Bernard 1888 - Self-portrait with Gauguin portrait for Vincent.jpeg
artist: Émile Bernard
description:
Self-portrait with portrait of Paul Gauguin, dedicated to Vincent van Gogh - "à son copaing [slang for "for his fellow"] Vincent, 1888"

Van Gogh had asked Bernard for a portrait of Gauguin, but Bernard did not feel able to create such (Gauguin, 20 years older [twice the age of Bernard!], was already famous at this time). Van Gogh however was totally fond of Bernard's painting, for its simplicity, and compared it to "a genuine Manet".

Gauguin painted, to "compensate", a self-portrait "with portrait of Bernard" in same year. Both paintings are held by VGM.
